related.title: 自旋到電荷讀出：混淆矩陣與平均保真度
related.titleEn: Spin-to-charge readout: confusion matrices and mean fidelity
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：只有已納入上升／下降面積的模型可對照真波形；兩個相同峰值但不同面積不可視為同閘。 另一位學徒須能從輸入與算式重算，而非僅讀結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Compare real waveforms only after including rise/fall area; equal peaks with different areas are not equal gates. A second learner must be able to reconstruct the result from inputs and equations.
related.difference: 由兩類條件正確率建立讀出混淆矩陣，避免用不平衡樣本隱藏弱類別。
related.differenceEn: Build a readout confusion matrix from class-conditional accuracy without hiding a weak class in imbalanced samples.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。方形模型脈衝J/h=10MHz；無上升時間、洩漏與退相干。 t=1/(4×10MHz)，再換成ns。 代入 1/(4*10e6)*1e9，得到 25 ns。H=J S₁·S₂，以無因次自旋算符表示；sqrt-SWAP需Jt/ħ=π/2，因此t=1/(4J/h)。忽略場梯度。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。

以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。準備0與1各1000次，正確分類980與940次；本題先假設準備完美。 F=(980/1000+940/1000)/2。 代入 (980/1000+940/1000)/2，得到 0.96 dimensionless。均勻先驗下平均指派保真度F=(P(0|0)+P(1|1))/2；真實先驗不均時總準確率不同。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. Square model pulse J/h=10MHz with no rise time, leakage or dephasing. t=1/(4×10MHz), converted tons. Substituting 1/(4*10e6)*1e9 gives 25 ns. For H=J S1·S2 with dimensionless spins, sqrt-SWAP needsJt/ħ=π/2, so t=1/(4J/h), neglecting gradients. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.

Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. Prepare0 and1 each1000 times; classify980 and940 correctly, initially assuming perfect preparation. F=(980/1000+940/1000)/2. Substituting (980/1000+940/1000)/2 gives 0.96 dimensionless. For equal priors assignment fidelityF=[P(0|0)+P(1|1)]/2; overall accuracy differs with unequal priors. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.differenceEn: Use explicit synthetic likelihoods to show why one positive signal cannot uniquely identify topology.

Purely teaching hypothesesH/A: priorH=0.01,P(D|H)=0.8,P(D|A)=0.2; these are not estimates for any experiment. Posterior=(0.8×0.01)/(0.8×0.01+0.2×0.99). Substituting 0.8*0.01/(0.8*0.01+0.2*0.99) gives 0.038835 dimensionless. Bayes posteriorP(H|D)=P(D|H)P(H)/[P(D|H)P(H)+P(D|A)P(A)]; conclusions depend on hypotheses and likelihoods. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.
